title: Prasarita Padottanasana · Wide fold anatomy
summary: Both hips hinge with the legs spread apart and the arms descending toward the floor.

joint_actions.action: forward hinge between the spread legs

instruction.posture: A wide-foot standing fold with a long-leg reference and relaxed arms.

transitions.cue: The reference animation moves from neutral into the displayed joint arrangement.
The final frames return the fitted reference toward neutral.

modifications.note: A chair supports a shallower fold with a higher trunk position.

variations.note: The authored clip may be viewed over a smaller angular range.

cautions: This is an anatomical display, not a recommendation to attempt the posture or match its range.
safety.notes: Suitability, balance, loading, and individual restrictions are outside this visualization.

source.tradition_basis: Project-authored anatomical study using posture names listed by Iyengar Yoga organizations; no teacher sequence or instructional wording is copied.
source.rights_basis: provisional: project-authored record and animation using a procedural fitted-reference body; no third-party movement media or anatomy asset is packaged
